title: Agent Skills + Autoresearch Extension Catalog
principle: Keep the dashboard simple for operators while giving the AI agent repeatable, auditable skills for research, risk prediction, approval, and proof.

skills.label: Clarify operator ask
skills.trigger: A planner, buyer, or executive asks an ambiguous supply-chain question.

skills.label: Map ERP/MES source records
skills.trigger: A card needs traceability to PO, WO, inventory, production, shipment, or supplier portal data.

skills.label: Convert live news into commodity risk
skills.trigger: Commodity, logistics, supplier, policy, or price signal arrives from RSS/API/manual research.

skills.label: Build governed decision packet
skills.trigger: Risk is high enough to need manager approval or external writeback.

skills.label: Autoresearch risk sprint
skills.trigger: The model needs a measurable improvement for forecast, supplier, inventory, or news-risk prediction.

autoresearch_extensions.label: Commodity arrangement research
autoresearch_extensions.goal: Find early signals that should change buy timing, buffer targets, LTA strategy, or supplier allocation.
autoresearch_extensions.promotion_gate: Earlier warning without increasing false-positive approval work.
autoresearch_extensions.evidence_policy: log hypothesis, dataset, baseline, candidate result, operator impact, and promote/reject decision

autoresearch_extensions.label: Forecast-capacity gap research
autoresearch_extensions.goal: Detect demand/capacity mismatches before customer commitment misses.
autoresearch_extensions.promotion_gate: Lower forecast exception noise and better service-impact ranking.
autoresearch_extensions.evidence_policy: log hypothesis, dataset, baseline, candidate result, operator impact, and promote/reject decision

autoresearch_extensions.label: Supplier recovery playbook research
autoresearch_extensions.goal: Compare supplier ticket, expedite, allocation, substitute, and redesign paths using historical receipts.
autoresearch_extensions.promotion_gate: Improves recovery recommendation precision and keeps human approval for external changes.
autoresearch_extensions.evidence_policy: log hypothesis, dataset, baseline, candidate result, operator impact, and promote/reject decision

operating_loop: clarify business ask or ingest live signal
map ERP/MES/WMS/TMS/news records to ontology objects
detect risk and produce a human-readable decision packet
run bounded autoresearch only when a measurable prediction improvement is needed
require human approval before external-system change
write back through governed connector and attach EvidenceReceipt / BlockchainAnchor proof
simple_ui_rule: Simple default UI shows major issue, affected object, recommended action, approval owner, target system, and proof; raw ERP/MES tables stay behind source references.
